en.title: Global Macro — Sovereign borrowing costs turn the energy shock into a fiscal constraint
en.deck: IMF sovereign-yield evidence and new projections reveal how energy prices interact with debt maturity, fiscal support and financial liquidity.
en.regime: Persistently higher energy costs can coincide with slower real growth and more expensive government refinancing.
en.key_risk: Refinancing needs and nonbank liquidity strains amplify gradual fiscal pressure into funding volatility.
